title: Isolation and enrichment of mouse splenic T cells for ex vivo and in vivo T cell receptor stimulation assays
protocol: Euthanize mice according to institutional guidelines.
Collect the spleen using scissors and tweezers.
Place the spleen in a 6-well plate containing few milliliters of PBS/2% FBS and keep at room temperature.
Place the spleen on a 70 μm cell strainer.
Dilacerate the organ with the piston of a syringe.
After centrifugation, observe for red cell pellet indicating presence of red blood cells.
Treat the sample with RBC lysis buffer to deplete red cells from the cell pellet.
Stain cells with trypan blue and count live cells using a hemocytometer.
Euthanize mice using carbon dioxide.
Place the euthanized mouse on a dissection board.
Sterilize the skin using 70% ethanol.
Cut through the skin and muscle layer using sterile scissors.
Visualize the spleen next to the stomach on the left side of the mouse.
Remove the spleen, trimming away any non-specific tissue.
Place the spleen in a six-well plate containing 3 mL of PBS1×/2%FBS.
Put a 70 μm cell strainer on top of a 50 mL conical tube.
Moisten the cell strainer with PBS1×/2%FBS.
Dilacerate the spleen on the cell strainer using the piston of a syringe.
Add PBS1×/2%FBS to facilitate dilaceration.
Adjust the volume to 20 mL for each tube with PBS1×/2%FBS.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 7 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 2 mL of Red Blood Cells lysis buffer on the cell pellet.
Resuspend cells by pipetting and incubate 10 min at RT.
Centrifuge (450 × g, 7 min, RT).
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet with 10 mL of PBS1×/2%FBS.
Take 5 μL of cells and mix them with 45 μL of trypan blue diluted at a 1:1 ratio with PBS1×.
Load cell mixture into a hemocytometer.
Using a microscope, count viable cells which correspond to bright cells that are not stained in blue.
Centrifuge conical tubes containing 10 mL of cell suspension at 450 × g (7 min, RT).
Resuspend the pellet in PBS1×/2%FBS to achieve a concentration of 1 × 10^8 cells/mL.
Transfer 10^6 cells into a 5 mL polystyrene tube (FACS tube).
Add for each sample, 5 μL of antibodies cocktail n°1 and FACS buffer up to 100 μL.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 2 mL of PBS1×.
Centrifuge cells at 650 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of FACS Buffer.
Acquire cells on a flow cytometer (e.g., BD Canto).
Analyze files using software such as FlowJo.
Transfer 5 × 10^7 cells into a FACS tube.
Add 25 μL of Normal Rat Serum to the cell suspension.
Add 25 μL of EasySepTM Mouse T cell isolation cocktail to the mixture.
Incubate the mixture for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Vortex EasySepTM Streptavidin RapidSpheresTM for 30 seconds.
Transfer 37.5 μL of the vortexed solution into the cell suspension.
Incubate the combined solution for 2.5 minutes at RT.
Add 2 mL PBS1×/2%FBS and pipette mix gently (avoid vortexing).
Place the FACS tube on a magnet and wait for 2.5 minutes at RT.
Transfer the cell suspension into a new 15 mL conical collection tube by inverting the magnet/FACS tube in a single continuous motion.
Count cells as described in steps 11 and 12.
Take an aliquot (around 50 μL of cell suspension) for FACS analysis.
Stain cells with 5 μL of antibodies cocktail n°2.
Centrifuge cells (450 × g, 7 min, RT).
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet at 2 × 10^7 cells/mL in PBS1×.
Dilute CTV stock solution (5 mM) at 1:1000 with PBS1× and protect from light.
Add 20 μL diluted CTV (5 μM) to 3 × 10^6 cells in 1 mL PBS1×.
Mix well by gentle pipetting.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 min (in the dark).
Wash cells twice with 500 μL of cold PBS1×.
Spin cells (700 × g, 5 min, 4°C).
Resuspend cell pellet in complete RPMI or PBS1× and store at 4°C in the dark until use.
Resuspend cells in complete RPMI at a concentration of 3 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Dispatch 10^6 cells of each sample into two wells of a 48-well plate for 'Not stimulated' condition.
Add 10 μL Dynabeads Mouse T-activator CD3/CD28 to the well for 'Stimulated CD3/CD28'.
Optionally, dispatch another set of cells in a third well and add Phorbol myristate acetate (PMA) and ionomycin.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Resuspend cells by gentle pipetting after 24 hours for analysis.
Take 100 μL of resuspended cells into FACS tube.
Add 1 mL PBS1× to each sample.
For stimulated cells, put the tube on a magnet and wait for 2 minutes.
Collect the supernatant into another FACS tube.
Centrifuge cells at 700 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 5 μL of antibodies cocktail n°3 and FACS Buffer to a final volume of 100 μL per sample.
Incubate samples in the dark at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Wash cells by adding 2 mL of Annexin-V binding buffer 1×.
Centrifuge cells at 650 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 100 μL of Annexin-V binding buffer 1×.
Add 1 μL of Annexin-V APC to each sample.
Acquire cells on a flow cytometer and analyze data using FlowJo software.
At 72 hours, repeat all steps from centrifuging the cells through adding Annexin-V APC.
Resuspend CTV-labelled cells at a concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL in PBS at room temperature, protecting them from light.
Sedate C57BL/6 recipient mice using isoflurane with a flow rate of 4 L/min for 3 minutes.
Inject 100 μL of cells intravenously (retro orbital injection) using an insulin syringe or a 1 mL syringe with a 30 gauge needle.
Place grafted mice under a heating lamp until they wake up and return them to their cage.
Allow mice to recover for two days.
Anesthetize grafted mice as described in step 51 after recovery.
Inject 100 μg of ovalbumin subcutaneously into the ear of each mouse, along with complete Freund’s adjuvant, mixing both solutions thoroughly beforehand.
Place injected mice under a heating lamp until they wake up.
Euthanize grafted mice three to five days post-immunization for analysis.
Collect cervical lymph nodes, trimming away non-specific tissue.
Place the lymph nodes in PBS1×/2%FBS at room temperature (RT).
Put a 70 μm cell strainer on a 50 mL conical tube.
Moisten the cell strainer with PBS1×/2%FBS and place the lymph nodes on it.
Dilacerate the lymph nodes with the piston of a syringe.
Adjust the volume to 10 ml with PBS1×/2%FBS.
Centrifuge cells at 450 × g for 7 minutes at RT.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet with 5 ml of PBS1×/2%FBS.
Count cells as described in steps 11 and 12.
Transfer 10^6 cells into a FACS tube.
Add 5 μl of antibodies cocktail n°4 and FACS Buffer up to 100 μL for each sample.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C, in the dark.
Add 2 ml PBS1× and centrifuge at 650 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 100 μl of FACS buffer.
Acquire cells on a flow cytometer.
Analyze files using FlowJo software.
